تحتبسون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَبِسُونَ (taḥtabisūna) /taħ.ta.bi.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# تُحْتَبَسُونَ (tuḥtabasūna) /tuħ.ta.ba.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
